content.title: Trump Comment Halts Argentina Stock Rally
content.summary: Argentina's stock market took a hit Tuesday after President Trump made clear that his administration's support for the struggling South American nation is contingent on an election victory two weeks from now by the party of his preferred candidate, right-leaning President Javier Milei.  The S&P Merval index of Argentina's major stocks was down 3% Tuesday after Trump said of the Oct. 26 election, "If he loses, we will not be generous with Argentina."  Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent last week said the U.S. bought pesos, an effort to support Milei's party at a time when his economic reforms are being held responsible for high unemployment and soft growth.
